summary.text: Ryan Gill is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 68 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the Republican primary was canceled.
A cattle rancher, he served on the Hillsborough Soil and Water Conservation District from 2023 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Gill was born in East Hillsborough, Florida, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a cattle rancher.

He has served as a board member of the Plant City Chamber, the Hillsborough County Cattlemen's Association and the Hillsborough County Cattlemen's Foundation, and as a chairman of the Hillsborough County Soil and Water Conservation District and of the Beef Breed Show at the Florida Strawberry Festival.
Gill held Seat 2 on the Hillsborough Soil and Water Conservation District from January 3, 2023, to January 7, 2025, and did not run for re-election in 2024.
